beats.line: the increased absorption of nitrogen under deep pressure
and it makes divers feel completely intoxicated
essentially like being drunk. So you're probably thinking
hey, cave diving is actually beginning to sound not so bad
Well the issue is that when people are drunk they tend to make terrible decisions
by taking unnecessary risks, losing track of time
and becoming uncoordinated. Now of course that shouldn't be a problem for you
since you were never coordinated to begin with. But let's say
you manage to squeeze and twist through this terrible section anyway
you'll now have to move past maze-like narrow passages
